issues.evidence: Fresh probes found native/forced-fallback public output drift for numeric div/mod decimal rendering, 32-bit integer overflow typing, and compatible Quantity arithmetic such as 1 'cm' + 10 'mm', 1 'cm' * 10 'mm', and 1 'cm' / 10 'mm'.
issues.root_cause: Python fallback preserved arbitrary-size Integer arithmetic and left/compound Quantity display units while native overflow-promoted to Decimal and canonicalized compatible Quantity operands. Native numeric div/mod also exposed decimal/binary formatting differences, and native same-dimension Quantity division returned a bare Decimal instead of the official dimensionless Quantity shape.
issues.resolution: Aligned both backends on public DuckDB surfaces: Python fallback promotes 32-bit integer overflow to Decimal and canonicalizes compatible Quantity arithmetic to base units; native div returns Integer where applicable, mod preserves rounded decimal source text, and compatible same-dimension Quantity division returns dimensionless Quantity '1'. Rebuilt/copied the native extension and added public-surface regression coverage.
